Synopsis:
Jaheira and Minsc confront the Dark Urge about their recent revelation they are a Bhaalspawn. Depending on how much the player has given into Bhaal, they are either more sympathetic, or almost hostile. But either way, they are supportive and want to use their knowledge of fighting alongside Bhaalspawn in the past to convince you that you can do good

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_DarkUrge_CFM_BloodweddingFollowup.json: The scene takes place in camp just after you’ve revealed (or been revealed as) a Bhaalspawn — you’ve been having blood‑filled dreams and have only just woken to find Jaheira and Minsc watching over you. Off‑screen they’ve been aware of your visions and of the dangerous legacy you carry, so Jaheira approaches warily with weapons drawn while Minsc looms protectively but warmly. Both have prior experience with Bhaalspawn‑touched people and use that knowledge to warn you of the violence the “birthright” can inspire while insisting you can still choose to do good. Their tone and firmness will vary based on how much you have yielded to Bhaal’s urges, but their goal is the same: to restrain the darkness and convince you there is another way.
- LOW_BhaalTemple_PostBattleDarkUrge_Acceptance.json: The Dark Urge accepted Bhaal when he appeared. Now, Jaheira and Minsc challenge and try to take down the DU, if they were encountered and survived until this point in the game.If the Jaheira/Minsc scene cannot trigger, there will be fallback comments from the party.
- CAMP_DarkUrge_Bloodwedding_SD_Nested_InWorld.json: The scene takes place inside the Bhaal temple where the Dark Urge protagonist and Orin the Red confront one another beneath a looming idol of Bhaal; a disembodied “butler”/temple voice (Sceleritas/Bhaal’s butler) narrates and reveals truths the player’s memory obscures. Off‑screen events leading here include Orin’s prior provocations in the city (and her role as a Bhaal Chosen) and the player’s brutal past killings — if the player followed the Embracing track, spectres of those victims appear in the vision. Only one of the two (either Orin or the player) will assume the Slayer form here; in most non‑Dark‑Urge playthroughs Orin transforms and combat follows, while if the Dark Urge player becomes the Slayer the scene branches into an immediate post‑transformation exchange (often Jaheira speaking about the Slayer, if she’s present). The butler’s voice frames the encounter as a family reunion and presses the player to confront their heritage and/or destroy their kin.
- CAMP_DarkUrge_Bloodwedding_SD.json: The scene is a waking vision inside the Bhaal temple: the Dark Urge and Orin face one another beneath a glowing Bhaal icon while Sceleritas Fel — Bhaal’s butler/door‑guardian — narrates as a disembodied voice rather than appearing in person. The Butler frames the player as a spawn of Bhaal, dredging up memories of murder and urging that only one Chosen may inherit the Slayer birthright, pressing the player to slay the “sister” before them. If the player followed the Embracing track, the vision includes spectres of past victims; otherwise it still presents vivid recollections and Bhaal’s claim. Only one character will assume the Slayer form here, and if the Dark Urge becomes the Slayer the cutscene should immediately transition into the companion reaction/dialogue (e.g., Jaheira) afterward. Orin’s taunts reflect an established, antagonistic rivalry tied to earlier city events and the wider plot.
- CAMP_AstarionHunger_IVB_SCO_Avatar_Choice.json: Astarion wakes up from a terrifying dream of his old master. His master had forbidden him to drink humanoid blood, but his master wasn't there... Astarion looks at the sleeping companions and considers biting one of them. If he does, he rolls a stealth check. If he succeeds, he sucks their blood (he can stop or decide to drain them dry). If he fails they wake up, and have to be convinced not to leave him.

- Jaheira: Dark dreams? (node 127)
- Jaheira: I think I can guess. Visions of blood on your hands. The blood in your veins, perhaps. (node 9)
- Jaheira: For all the gifts Bhaal's children inherit - a peaceful night's sleep is not among them. || [context] CinematicNodeContext: Jaheira steps forward, and we see that she's holding her scimitars, blades bared. (node 0)
- GROUP_ORI_DU: So the game is up at last. (node 138)
- Minsc: No game. A serious matter, to rouse Boo from his beauty sleep. || [context] CinematicNodeContext: Minsc suddenly looms on the player's other side, surrounding them. He carries no weapon, but his hulking presence is threatening nonetheless. (node 155)

context: This scene occurs in camp immediately after the Dark Urge’s Bhaalspawn identity has been revealed and after the player wakes from bloody, violent visions. Off‑screen Jaheira and Minsc have been watching over you and aware of your nightmares and the dangerous legacy they signal, so Jaheira approaches warily with her scimitars drawn while Minsc looms protectively at her side. Both companions have prior experience with people touched by Bhaal and use that knowledge to warn you about the violence the “birthright” can inspire, but they insist you can still choose to do good.
